Text Link

Two variants for two contexts: Plain for general/marketing pages — coloured text, no underline. Underline for long-form content (blog, news) — neutral text, a separate underline that thickens and darkens on hover.

2 variants2 modesToken-driven

Preview

Save 80% on all 10 products with the new Iron Suite

Save 80% on all 10 products with the new Iron Suite

Variants

Pick by context, not by preference — a whole page of underlined links reads as dense; a whole page of colour-only links loses the underline's scan-ability in long copy.
Plain general / marketing
For homepages, feature sections, and marketing copy. Coloured text draws the eye immediately — no underline keeps hero and feature sections looking clean. No underline in any state.
Native vs Remote Engine
States
Native vs Remote EngineDefault · --color-text-link
Native vs Remote EngineHover · --color-text-link-hover
Underline content — blog, news
For long-form reading — blog posts, articles, release notes. Text stays neutral so paragraphs stay easy to read; the underline alone carries the link, thickening on hover for extra confirmation.
Native vs Remote Engine
States
Native vs Remote EngineDefault · 50% · 1px
Native vs Remote EngineHover · 100% · 1.5px

Modes

Both variants have a dark-background pairing (code blocks, dark sections) using the dark-mode tokens — currently the same colours as light mode, kept separate for when dark mode diverges.

External links

external adds target="_blank" rel="noopener" and a trailing north-east arrow. The arrow is an icon, not a ↗ character — Montserrat has no glyph at U+2197, so a character would change size with the reader's machine. It is sized in em, so it tracks whatever run the link sits in, and carries aria-hidden so it adds nothing to the link's accessible name.

Code

<!-- plain — general / marketing pages -->
<p>Save 80% on all 10 products with the new
  <a href="/iron-suite" class="tlink plain">Iron Suite</a>
</p>

<!-- underline — long-form content (blog, news) -->
<p>Save 80% on all 10 products with the new
  <a href="/iron-suite" class="tlink underline">Iron Suite</a>
</p>

<!-- on a dark background -->
<a href="/docs" class="tlink underline dark">Create Blank PDF</a>

<!-- external link -->
<a href="https://example.com" class="tlink plain" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
  Learn more <svg class="ext-icon" viewBox="-64 -64 640 640" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path transform="rotate(-45 256 256)" d="M502.6 278.6…"/></svg>
</a>
.tlink { font-weight: 600; transition: color .15s, text-decoration-color .15s, text-decoration-thickness .15s; }

/* plain — coloured text, no underline */
.tlink.plain { color: var(--color-text-link); }
.tlink.plain:hover { color: var(--color-text-link-hover); }
.tlink.plain.dark { color: var(--color-text-dark-link); }
.tlink.plain.dark:hover { color: var(--color-text-dark-link-hover); }

/* underline — neutral text, thickening underline on hover */
.tlink.underline {
  color: var(--color-text-body);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-border-selected) 50%, transparent);
  text-decoration-thickness: var(--border-width-1);
  text-underline-offset: 21.5%;
}
.tlink.underline:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--color-border-selected); text-decoration-thickness: var(--border-width-1-5); }
.tlink.underline.dark { color: var(--color-text-dark-body); text-decoration-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-border-dark-alt) 50%, transparent); }
.tlink.underline.dark:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--color-border-dark-alt); }

Guidelines

✓ Do
Iron Suite Iron Suite
  • Use plain on marketing/general pages, underline inside long-form content (blog, news).
  • Use .dark on dark backgrounds so contrast holds.
  • Add the external-link icon (.ext-icon) when the link leaves the current site.
✗ Don't
Iron Suite
  • Don't mix variants on the same page for the same kind of link — pick one per context.
  • Don't drop the underline on underline variant — colour alone isn't enough contrast.
  • Don't use this for buttons — that's a Button component.
